text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Gwaaaah, the "Japanese Derby"!
Entering? Me?
If I wanna run in it, I can, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"The insane pressure has got me super-duper bawling, but...
I'll do it! I'm running, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The Derby... I can't afford to lose here, absolutely not!
I'm going to make this my race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Ryan is super motivated...
Ryan's crazy, but what's even crazier to me is~

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hallo hallo calisthenics~♪
One-two, one-two!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Having the same running style is so not fetch~!
Ines Fujin with her god-tier runaway blast~.

—Ines Fujin.
Mejiro Ryan's roommate, and a front-runner regarded
as one of the strongest in her generation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If Ines runs away at the front, and I run away too...
could it be that we'll duel it out and crash together~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
To prevent that, maybe I'll go say a quick hello to loosen things up.
Don't freak out, don't freak out, phew~~~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hey there, Ines!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah, Palmer-chan☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's Derby day, y'know? For now, wanna just chill together
and share the mellow vibes?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And then, Ryan could totally get into the groove
and have a blast with us! Woohoo~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Even if they're a Mejiro, I won't let ill-mannered girls
hold Ryan-chan's lead♪
And another thing—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm not giving up the lead either!
If you try to make a move, you'll regret it, okay?
Big sis says that's a no-no!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Bye-bye~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa~. I thought I'd loosen you up,
but it backfired~!? Trainer...!

Seeing Mejiro Palmer losing her composure,
I instinctively signaled to her with hand gestures.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? That's right. This, this...
I gotta get my heart racing to calm down...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Right. It's not about the other girls.
First and foremost, I need to focus on my own running!"
